description: Defines the 'pucch_helper' class with methods for computing NR-PUCCH group sequences and cyclic shift hopping indices, including dependencies on sequence generators and radio resource parameters.

classes.name: pucch_helper
classes.description: Helper class for PUCCH sequence and cyclic shift computations in 5G NR.

methods.name: compute_group_sequence
methods.description: Computes the NR-PUCCH group sequence based on group hopping configuration and scrambling ID.

methods.name: get_alpha_index
methods.description: Calculates the NR alpha index for cyclic shift hopping based on slot, cyclic prefix, and other parameters.
